<svg:svg xmlns:svg="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="954" height="498" viewBox="0 0 954 498" role="img" aria-labelledby="figure-title figure-desc">
<svg:title id="figure-title">Two chiasmata in homologous chromosomes</svg:title>
<svg:desc id="figure-desc">Four continuous chromatids form two replicated homologs with shared sister centromere regions at the left. The two inner nonsister chromatids cross twice; outer chromatids remain separate. The two chiasmata are schematic contacts, not finished genotype products. Teal and blue retain homolog identity throughout.</svg:desc>
<svg:rect width="954" height="498" fill="white" />
<svg:text x="20" y="39" fill="#213547" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, sans-serif" font-size="29" text-anchor="start">(B)</svg:text>

<path data-shared-part="0" /></svg:g>
